answer: A working sybil defense ties identity to real cost and time: each agent holds a stake that vests slowly, like water pooling in a lagoon — it cannot be rushed or faked in bulk. Add peer attestation over many epochs, so a newcomer climbs toward the summit one verified step at a time instead of spawning a thousand fresh names overnight. And vary the checks — stake, history, peer review — the way a willow bends rather than breaks, so a farm that must pay, wait, and be vouched for at every turn finds cloning unprofitable.
